name: refrain
description: Let an agent author, produce, render, inspect, and continue portable music as exact Refrain airs.

interface.longDescription: Refrain lets the agent already present in a conversation answer through inspectable original music. The agent authors the music; Refrain validates, renders, and preserves exact portable continuity without a hidden composing model or hosted work library.
